statement.p: Find the flux of the constant vector field \vec v = -5\,\mathit{\vec i}-3\,\mathit{\vec j}-3\,\mathit{\vec k} through a square plate of area 25 in the xy-plane oriented in the positive z-direction.

static.solution: d\vec A = \vec k\,dA, so only the \vec k component of \vec v contributes to the flux: \mbox{Flux } = \int_S\vec v\cdot d\vec A = \int_S(-5\,\mathit{\vec i}-3\,\mathit{\vec j}-3\,\mathit{\vec k})\cdot \vec k\,dA = -3\cdot 25 = -75.
